env TZ=UTC
at 2026-08-05T12:00:00Z
mkdir source

exec card --store $WORK/source init --no-config --prefix batch- --board-name Large
exec card --store $WORK/source config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

# Generate enough issues to require another repository page without making the
# fixture or assertions exhaustive.
exec jq -n -f generate-issues.jq
cp stdout $WORK/issues.json
exec card --store $WORK/source --board Large apply $WORK/issues.json
stdout '^applied document: 129 create, 0 update, 0 skip, 0 no change$'

exec card --json --store $WORK/source --board Large backup $WORK/large.cardamom
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/backup.json
exec card --json --store $WORK/destination restore $WORK/large.cardamom
cmpenv stdout $WORK/golden/restore.json

# Verify the restored population and representative records around the
# repository page boundary through public JSON output.
exec card --json --store $WORK/destination --board Large list --limit 0
cp stdout $WORK/restored.jsonl
exec jq -sc -f summarize-restored.jq $WORK/restored.jsonl
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/restored-summary.json

-- generate-issues.jq --
{
  version: 1,
  issues: [
    range(1; 130) as $number
    | {
        alias: "issue-\($number)",
        title: "Transfer issue \($number)",
        type: "task",
        summary: "Payload \($number) survives backup and restore.",
        labels: {
          values: (
            if $number == 1 then ["marker:first"]
            elif $number == 128 then ["marker:boundary"]
            elif $number == 129 then ["marker:continuation"]
            else ["transfer"]
            end
          )
        }
      }
  ]
}
-- summarize-restored.jq --
. as $issues
| {
    count: ($issues | length),
    representatives: (
      [
        $issues[]
        | select(.id == "batch-1" or .id == "batch-128" or .id == "batch-129")
        | {id, title, summary, labels}
      ]
      | sort_by(.id | ltrimstr("batch-") | tonumber)
    )
  }
-- golden/backup.json --
{"source":"$WORK/source","destination":"$WORK/large.cardamom","projects":1,"boards":1,"blobs":0}
-- golden/restore.json --
{"source":"$WORK/large.cardamom","destination":"$WORK/destination","projects":1,"boards":1,"blobs":0,"already_completed_boards":0}
-- golden/restored-summary.json --
{"count":129,"representatives":[{"id":"batch-1","title":"Transfer issue 1","summary":"Payload 1 survives backup and restore.","labels":["marker:first"]},{"id":"batch-128","title":"Transfer issue 128","summary":"Payload 128 survives backup and restore.","labels":["marker:boundary"]},{"id":"batch-129","title":"Transfer issue 129","summary":"Payload 129 survives backup and restore.","labels":["marker:continuation"]}]}
